dds_oldman_10.m: Who are you? Not here to steal my books, are you?
r: I once helped to find your book. Don't be rude!

dds_oldman_20.m: Sorry, there seem to be folks who want to take my books and not return them.
r: In fact, I'd like to borrow your copy of Calomyran Secrets.

dds_oldman_30.m: No can do. It's too rare and precious.

dds_oldman_40.m: Sounds serious. But, what's the book got to do with that?
r: I need a chant from it to break a Kazaul spell.
[Talking to self, while reading] So, this is the chant. Wait, this is half a chant! The books says the rest of the chant is written in another book - Azimyran Secrets.
Done. Here's your book back, thank you.

dds_oldman_64.m: Do I see greasy fingerprints there?
r: However, it is not complete. Do you also have the book Azimyran Secrets?

dds_oldman_70.m: No, sorry. Do let me know if you come across a copy.

fallhaven_oldman_1.m: Would you help an old man please?
r: Sure, what do you need help with?
I might. Are we talking about some kind of reward?
No, I won't help an old timer like you. Bye.

fallhaven_oldman_2.m: I recently lost a very valuable book of mine.

fallhaven_oldman_3.m: I know I had it with me yesterday. Now I can't seem to find it.

fallhaven_oldman_4.m: I never lose things! Someone must have stolen it, that's my guess.

fallhaven_oldman_5.m: Would you please go look for my book? It's called 'Calomyran Secrets'.

fallhaven_oldman_6.m:
I have no idea where it might be. You could go ask Arcir, he seems very fond of his books.
 [Points at the house to the south]
r: OK, I'll go ask Arcir. Goodbye.

fallhaven_oldman_complete.m: My book! Thank you, thank you! Where was it? No, don't tell me. Here, take these coins for your trouble.

fallhaven_oldman_complete_2.m: Thank you so much for finding my book!

fallhaven_oldman_continue.m: How is the search for my book going? It's called 'Calomyran Secrets'. Have you found my book?
r: No, I have not found it yet.
Could you tell me your story again please?

darkness_in_daylight.10: I met Miri in the Crossroads Guardhouse.
darkness_in_daylight.20: Since I had helped Ailshara, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.30: Since I had hidden the truth about the bootlegging of beer from Sullengard, she wouldn't tell me about Andor.
darkness_in_daylight.40: Since I had aided Feygard once or twice earlier, she would tell me about Andor, after I had completed an investigation for her.
darkness_in_daylight.50: Since Miri was poisoned by slitherers near Sullengard, and healing is taking time, she wanted me to investigate something bad in the Purple Hills in the strange areas to the south of Stoutford.
darkness_in_daylight.60: I went to the area to the south of Stoutford and encountered an impassable force there.
darkness_in_daylight.70: There was a piece of Kazaul ritual there, which I had encountered before. I should inform Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.80: Miri asked me where I had seen this before. I told her about a task I had carried out on behalf of Throdna of the Blackwater settlement.
darkness_in_daylight.90: Miri told me to meet him and enquire further. And gave me a phrase to use whenever he started rambling.
darkness_in_daylight.100: Throdna told me it was part of a ritual to break the barrier which forms when one does a ritual to call strong Kazaul monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.110: The ritual consisted of two parts which I had found earlier, and a chant in a book called Calomyran Secrets. I need to report this to Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.120: I told Miri about finding the book for an Old Man in Fallhaven.  She told me to talk to him.
darkness_in_daylight.130: The Old Man would not let me borrow the book, so I started noting the chant in front of him.
darkness_in_daylight.140: The book contained half the chant. The rest was to be found in another book Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.150: Miri told me she'd trace the book. She told me to wait for her return.
darkness_in_daylight.160: Miri came back and told me that the book Azimyran Secrets was with an old hermit near Arulir mountain.
darkness_in_daylight.170: I met the old hermit and asked him about the book, Azimyran Secrets.
darkness_in_daylight.180: He refused to give it to me, so I copied the chant sitting with him. I needed to tell Miri.
darkness_in_daylight.190: Miri told me to hurry, and pass the barrier.
darkness_in_daylight.198: After destroying the ritual statue of Kazaul, beyond the barrier I found a crying woman.
darkness_in_daylight.200: She was performing a ritual that should bring her husband back to life.
darkness_in_daylight.210: Miri, who followed me, convinced the woman that it was actually an evil ritual to overrun Dhayavar with Kazaul's monsters.
darkness_in_daylight.220: The mourning woman told us that the ritual was given to her by a priest who walks on lava east of the Purple Hills.
darkness_in_daylight.230: We let the mourning woman go.
darkness_in_daylight.232: The mourning woman cried that she would never be happy again.
darkness_in_daylight.240: I had to travel to the lava wastelands.
darkness_in_daylight.250: There, after fighting monsters, I met a priest in red.
darkness_in_daylight.260: He accused me of interfering. Miri, who again followed me, revealed the red priest to be a monster.
darkness_in_daylight.280: Miri fulfilled her promise and told me that Andor would be refilling his food supplies at Rosmara's food stand.
darkness_in_daylight.300: Indeed, I have found Andor there.
darkness_in_daylight.310: He told me he couldn't come home now, and vanished.

calomyran.10: An old man standing outside in Fallhaven has lost his book 'Calomyran Secrets'. I should go look for it. Maybe in Arcir's house to the south?
calomyran.20: I found a torn page of a book called 'Calomyran Secrets' with the name 'Larcal' written on it.
calomyran.100: I gave the book back to the old man.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
